description.narrative:
Inaction in the current complex humanitarian crisis would exacerbate the vulnerability of populations within these communities, undermining their access to essential resources. A lack of rapid and targeted intervention would intensify both food and physical insecurity, increasing the risks of malnutrition and violence—particularly for women and children. Under present conditions, the gradual deterioration in living standards could even result in loss of life due to inadequate access to healthcare and safe drinking water. In response to this emergency, immediate intervention is crucial to mitigate these risks and address the priority needs identified on the ground. While the challenges are diverse and complex, the SCLR approach would provide vital support to improve residents’ daily lives, especially in terms of water access, sanitation, protection, and livelihoods.
The project will provide micro-grants to a minimum of 6 vulnerable communities, empowering them to address the crises affecting them directly. As expected outcomes, the project will enhance social cohesion and community resilience, while directly reaching at least 750 people to improve their living conditions through the implementation of the community-led response.
